entries.title: Proverbs 10:1
segments: ¶The Proverbs of Solomon: A wise son makes a glad father, But a foolish son [is] the grief of his mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:2
segments: ¶Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, But righteousness delivers from death.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:3
segments: The LORD will not allow the righteous soul to famish, But He casts away the desire of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:4
segments: ¶He who has a slack hand becomes poor, But the hand of the diligent makes rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:5
segments: ¶He who gathers in summer [is] a wise son; He who sleeps in harvest [is] a son who causes shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:6
segments: ¶Blessings [are] on the head of the righteous, But violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:7
segments: ¶The memory of the righteous [is] blessed, But the name of the wicked will rot.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:8
segments: ¶The wise in heart will receive commands, But a prating fool will fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:9
segments: ¶He who walks with integrity walks securely, But he who perverts his ways will become known.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:10
segments: ¶He who winks with the eye causes trouble, But a prating fool will fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:11
segments: ¶The mouth of the righteous [is] a well of life, But violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:12
segments: ¶Hatred stirs up strife, But love covers all sins.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:13
segments: ¶Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has understanding, But a rod [is] for the back of him who is devoid of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:14
segments: ¶Wise [people] store up knowledge, But the mouth of the foolish [is] near destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:15
segments: ¶The rich man's wealth [is] his strong city; The destruction of the poor [is] their poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:16
segments: ¶The labor of the righteous [leads] to life, The wages of the wicked to sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:17
segments: ¶He who keeps instruction [is in] the way of life, But he who refuses correction goes astray.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:18
segments: ¶Whoever hides hatred [has] lying lips, And whoever spreads slander [is] a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:19
segments: ¶In the multitude of words sin is not lacking, But he who restrains his lips [is] wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:20
segments: ¶The tongue of the righteous [is] choice silver; The heart of the wicked [is worth] little.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:21
segments: The lips of the righteous feed many, But fools die for lack of wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:22
segments: ¶The blessing of the LORD makes [one] rich, And He adds no sorrow with it.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:23
segments: ¶To do evil [is] like sport to a fool, But a man of understanding has wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:24
segments: ¶The fear of the wicked will come upon him, And the desire of the righteous will be granted.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:25
segments: When the whirlwind passes by, the wicked [is] no [more], But the righteous [has] an everlasting foundation.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:26
segments: ¶As vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, So [is] the lazy [man] to those who send him.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:27
segments: ¶The fear of the LORD prolongs days, But the years of the wicked will be shortened.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:28
segments: The hope of the righteous [will be] gladness, But the expectation of the wicked will perish.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:29
segments: ¶The way of the LORD [is] strength for the upright, But destruction [will come] to the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:30
segments: The righteous will never be removed, But the wicked will not inhabit the earth.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:31
segments: ¶The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, But the perverse tongue will be cut out.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:32
segments: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, But the mouth of the wicked [what is] perverse.
